description: This file defines a React component named 'MenuLayout' which composes two sub-components (a list component and a panel component) into a layout with resizable sidebar functionality. It manages state for showing/hiding the panel, external properties, and handles drag interactions for adjusting sidebar width, with responsiveness considerations for mobile screens.

classes.name: MenuWrapperInspectProps
classes.description: Interface defining optional properties and index signature for menu component properties.

classes.name: MenuHood
classes.description: A functional component returned by 'MenuLayout' that composes the list and panel components into a layout with draggable resize and responsive behavior.

methods.name: MenuLayout
methods.description: Main exported function that creates the layout component, accepting list and panel components as parameters.
